content: Bɛɛ bibu, i swɑɑ dɑkio kirɔ ye bɛɛn tundo u bɛɛ mɔ̀. I swɑɑ tem kpĩiyɔ kpɑ i wɑ i bwisi ko.
Domi bwisi ɡeeyɑ nɑ bɛɛ kɛ̃mɔ. Yen sɔ̃, i ku nɛn sɔ̃ɔsinu yinɑ.
Sɑnɑm mɛ nɛn tii nɑ sɑ̃ɑ bii, nɑ wɑ̃ɑ nɛn tundon bɔkuɔ, mɑ nɑ sɑ̃ɑ nɛn mɛron bii teereru,
nɛn tundo u mɑn keu kuɑ u nɛɛ, n win ɡɑri nɛnuɔ. N win woodɑbɑ mɛm nɔɔwɔ, kpɑ n wɑ nɑ n wɑ̃ɑ.
N bwisi kɑ lɑɑkɑri nɛnuɔ, n ku win ɡere duɑri,
n ku bwisi yɔ̃su, yi koo mɑn somi. N yi kĩɔ, yi koo mɑn kɔ̃su.
Gɑ̃ɑ ni kon nɑɑ ɡirɑ sɔɔ, bwisiyɑ yi kpuro kere. Ǹ n mɛn nɑ, n yi kɑsuo kɑ ye nɑ mɔ kpuro.
N bwisi kĩɔ, yi koo de n ko tɔn boko. N yi tii bɔkɑsio, nɡe kurɔ kĩnɑsi, yi koo de n bɛɛrɛ wɑ.
Yi ko n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe sinɑ furɔ nɛn wirɔ.
A ku tɔn kɔ̃sobun dɑɑ sɑɑri
Nɛn bii, ɑ swɑɑ dɑkio ɑ nɔ ye nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔmɔ. À n ye wurɑ, wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru tɑ koo dɑkɑɑ dɑ.
Nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔsimɔwɑ nɡe mɛ kɑɑ kɑ bwisi dendi. Nɑ nun sɔ̃ɔsimɔwɑ nɡe mɛ kɑɑ kɑ ɡem swĩi.
Sɑɑ ye sɔɔ, kɑɑ sĩwɑ ɑ kun sokure. À n dukɑ mɔ̀, ɡɑ̃ɑnu kun mɑɑ nun ɡɑnumɔ wunɛn swɑɑ sɔɔ.
Sɔ̃ɔsi te bɑ nun kuɑ mi, ɑ ku tu yɔ̃su. A tu nɛnuɔ kem kem, domi terɑ tɑ sɑ̃ɑ wunɛn wɑ̃ɑrun nuuru.
A ku tɔn kɔ̃sobun dɑɑ sɑɑri. A ku mɑɑ ben yirɑ swĩi.
A ye derio, ɑ ku ye swĩi. A ye dukɑ suurio n tomɑ.
Domi bɑ̀ kun kɔ̃sɑ kue, bɑ ku rɑ dweeye. Bɑ̀ kun ɡoo torɑri, bɑ ku rɑ dom wɑ.
Kɔ̃sɑn kobɑ bu rɑ n sɑ̃ɑ nɡe ben dĩɑnu kɑ ben tɑm.
Gemɡibun kookoosu su rɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe bururun sɔ̃ɔ yɑnɑ ye yɑ rɑ n dɛɛrɑmɔ sere sɔ̃ɔ u kɑ ye mɑm mɑm.
Adɑmɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobun kookoosu su sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe yɑm wɔ̃kuru. Bɑ ǹ yɛ̃ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ sokurɑmɔ.
A de wunɛn kookoosu su n wɑ̃
Nɛn bii, ɑ nɛn ɡɑri nɔɔwɔ. A swɑɑ tem kpĩiyɔ ɑ nɔ bwisi yi kon nun kɛ̃.
A ku yi ɑtɑfiiru ko. A yi nɛnuɔ wunɛn ɡɔ̃run sɔɔwɔ.
Domi wi u yi mwɑ, yi koo nùn wɑ̃ɑru kɑ bwɑ̃ɑ dobu wɛ̃.
A de ɑ n tii sɛ kɑ bwisiku ni ɑ mɔ̀ wunɛn tii tii sɔɔ, domi niyɑ nu kpuro kere, niyɑ nu wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru kpɑre.
A ku de weesu kɑ ɡɑri kɑnkɑm yen ɡɑɑ yu yɑri wunɛn nɔɔn di.
A de ɑ n mɛɛrɑ ye ɑ nɑɑ ɡire. A ku wuswɑɑ sĩiyɑ.
A de ɑ n yɛ̃ swɑɑ ye kɑɑ kpe, kpɑ ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ yɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ swɑɑ ɡeɑ.
A ku yen ɡɑm ɡɛrɑ. A torɑru dukɑ suurio.
Kirɔ sɑkɑrɑrun sɔ̃
